name: @r4-adapters/shipping-http
description: R4-J2B production Shipping adapter of the Shipping port against pc-carrier's read contract (GET /location, GET /carrier/v1/all): transport, deadline, commune resolution by exact normalized match, schema validation, failure classification, explicit VAT derivation of the customer gross — no carrier, coverage or tariff logic. Outside R4 Core. Not bound in production.
